discoveries.text: In tests/checks/40 the contract run's suite ignores BROKEN, so its C merges a BROKEN file into origin main; a later run in that file whose suite tests BROKEN must `git rm` it first (the cont setup does).

Review Minor left: run_init pins testcount-source from the first check.out even when that suite was red (a failed first suite notes `no match`/`parsed (jest)` for the whole run); green markers written before a contract line (or a CHECK_CMD change via run.env, not in the tree key) keep the scraped count until the tree changes.
